name: Onboarding Tour page renders the seeded six-section tour
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, follows the sidebar 'Onboarding Tour' nav item (AC-34) to the repo-scoped tour at /repos/:repoId/onboarding (AC-32) and confirms the in-page table of contents lists all six catalogue section headings (AC-36), the 'ON THIS PAGE' rail label renders, and one known row from each of T13's seeded local_setup/critical_paths/routes_and_apis sections is present. Read-only: no header action is ever clicked, so no model call is spent. Distinct from 06-onboarding, which covers the unscoped add-repository screen at plain /onboarding.

steps.label: root redirects to the seeded repo's PRs (repo becomes active)
follow the sidebar nav item (AC-34) to the active repo's tour
the in-page table of contents label renders (AC-36)
a known seeded local_setup command row is present
a known seeded critical_paths row is present
a known seeded routes_and_apis entry is present
